negative_reviews.author: Maria Itiacandy
negative_reviews.text:
The drinks were the highlight...
The food was fine except for the dessert which I sent back and which was taken off the menu. The chocolate matcha brownie came with vanilla ice cream that was not defrosted or melted properly/ ready to be served to customers.  The chocolate sauce/syrup was awful it tasted like the  squeezy chocolate sauce you get in the supermarkets. The brownie itself had a strange texture that was neither gooey, dense, OR traditionally cakey for a brownie. The texture was on the tougher side. The flavour tasted like stolen/ christmas cake... Something was clearly wrong here. The server tried to allude to my racial background and say maybe that's why I didn't enjoy the desert... And maybe I'm not used to the matcha taste...which was inappropriate and I corrected her promptly. I like matcha but this dessert was awful. You can (try) see in the picture how pale the brownie looks....
